how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:priest-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3097:obj:0: Read the ⟦E5⟧ and speak to ⟦E6⟧ in the church in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:3097:details:0: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the priest trainer Duesten. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
rows.quest:3097:progress:0: Ah, so between fire, plague, rioting, and much worse, one more of the "faithful" comes to my door. Well, let me bid you welcome, ⟦2⟧. rows.quest:3097:completion:0: There is only one thing you must know: we have survived through will alone. It is faith in ourselves that separates us from others, and with our powers, we will cause great change in all of ⟦E10⟧. The weak will come to lean on you. The lepers will call you Lord. And the ignorant will look to you for guidance. It is my duty to make sure you have the necessary tools so when the time comes, you are prepared. As you grow in experience, seek me out. I will teach you greater powers if you are ready.
rows.quest:3103:obj:0: Read the ⟦E11⟧ and speak to ⟦E12⟧ in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:3103:details:0: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, ⟦5⟧. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of ⟦E12⟧, our local priest trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
rows.quest:3103:progress:0: Ah, at last you've come. I knew you would find your way to me. The ⟦E9⟧ shines upon you, and the path you've chosen. These times are harsh--the ⟦E14⟧ still has a presence upon ⟦E10⟧, the entirety of ⟦E15⟧ seeks new ways to defend itself from its own tribulations, and it is up to you to aid as many as you can.
rows.quest:3103:completion:0: As you grow in experience, return to me and I will do what I can to impart my knowledge upon you. Until then, go with compassion in your heart, and let wisdom be your guide. Remember, the world only becomes a better place if you make it so.

rows.quest:3119:progress:0: It pleases me to see you've arrived so quickly, ⟦10⟧. Welcome.⟦11⟧⟦12⟧As you've probably heard, all of ⟦E24⟧ is stirring with the comings and goings of travelers. rows.quest:5621:obj:0: Find ⟦E27⟧ and heal her wounds using ⟦E30⟧ (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant her Power Word: Fortitude and then return to ⟦E32⟧ in Dolanaar.
rows.quest:5621:details:0: I need your help, ⟦13⟧. I am needed here to train the other students, but you, you can help one of our injured Sentinels just south of Dolanaar. She was hurt patrolling the town and could use our aid. Her name is Shaya.
rows.quest:5621:details:1: When you find her, heal her wounds, and then fortify her body with your spells. This will at least protect her from harm longer if she finds trouble. Return to me here after you've done your duty to ⟦E33⟧.
rows.quest:5621:progress:0: Our spells of Fortify are very powerful, Delor. They allow our companions to take further injury from all types of attacks and survive in situations where they would normally fall. But this is nothing when compared to our abilities to heal. There are no greater healers than a priest--do well to remember that. Your power alone can turn the tides of battle easily.
rows.quest:5621:completion:0: You have done well and you have served ⟦E33⟧. For that, I thank you.
rows.quest:5621:completion:1: Please, take this robe as a token of my thanks. It signifies you have earned your place among our order. If you wish, wear it with pride, but either way, we will always recognize you as one of our own.
rows.quest:5622:details:0: ⟦15⟧, you must travel to Dolanaar when your business here in ⟦E26⟧ is done. There, you will find ⟦E32⟧. She will instruct you further in the ways of ⟦E33⟧, and it is with her that you will earn your first garments denoting your station as a ⟦16⟧ of ⟦E33⟧.
rows.quest:5622:details:1: Take care, and may you be protected in your journeys.

rows.quest:5623:details:0: Hello again, young ⟦18⟧. The time has come for you to learn more about our religion. rows.quest:5623:completion:0: I'm glad you've arrived, ⟦19⟧. We have much to discuss about your future and your path within the Light.
rows.quest:5624:obj:0: Find ⟦E38⟧ and heal his wounds using ⟦E30⟧ (Rank 2). Afterwards, grant him Power Word: Fortitude and then return to ⟦E35⟧ in Goldshire.

rows.quest:5624:progress:0: As you may have already learned, our healing magics are vital to the survival of our people in these harsh times--especially to adventurers and heroes who take up arms and magic to fight back so many different threats.⟦22⟧⟦23⟧You would do well to always remember how important that skill is. rows.quest:5650:completion:0: You have passed my test with ease. Good.
